Country/Region of Origin: Italy (Bologna, Campli and Montorio in Teramo).
Time Period: Early 18th century (special Cucù packs from Bologna); early 1900s documented.
Historical Development: Italian card exchange game; special Cucù cards made since early 18th century; descendant still played in Campli and Montorio al Vomano.
Cultural Significance: Traditional Italian social and family game.
